outcome: pregnancy complications (miscarriage, gestational diabetes mellitus, gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, gestational itching with effect on liver)
cohort: The study included 1413 women booking a first prenatal visit in 192 randomly selected General Practices in East Denmark.
finding: Women experiencing pelvic girdle pain, pelvic cavity pain, or vaginal bleeding in the first trimester had a higher risk of pregnancy complications later on, but no associations were found between early pregnancy symptoms and birth complications.
